_comment: Demo reference data. See README.md in this directory before loading. Parties and constituencies here are fictional; state codes are real because the campaign dashboard is organised on them, and the loader records each state's previous stage so --purge can restore it exactly.

states.note: DEMO: A private member's Bill proposing recall for municipal and assembly representatives was referred to the Committee on Law and Justice, which has invited public submissions until the end of the session.
DEMO: A petition signed by residents across all seven parliamentary constituencies was submitted to the Chief Minister's office, asking the government to bring a Bill in the next session.
DEMO: A Bill providing for the recall of members of the Legislative Assembly was introduced and has been listed for a second reading.
DEMO: Volunteer groups in four districts have run public meetings on the recall proposal; no formal demand has yet been submitted to the government.
DEMO: A series of college and panchayat-level discussions on the constitutional case for recall has been held over the last quarter.
DEMO: Signature collection has begun in three districts ahead of a formal representation to the state government.
